Family

We had a good experience at this hotel. Our family stayed for 5 days and everything went smoothly. The complimentary breakfast was nice, drinking water was provided free of cost throughout our stay. Hot showers were available 24/7. Special thanks to Mr. Sachin and the staff for being so attentive and prompt in fulfilling our requests. Initially, the bedsheets provided were not up to the mark, but when we asked for a change, they immediately replaced them without any hesitation.

Overall, the service was good, and the staff were courteous and helpful. We truly would recommend this hotel to others.

negative_snippets:
I stayed at Treebo Elegant Palace and my experience was extremely disappointing.

The room condition was very poor. There was no water supply, and the TV was not working despite complaining 3–4 times to the staff. No action was taken. The bed sheets were used and unclean, clearly not changed before allotting the room.

The food quality was third class and highly unhygienic. Food was served in dirty and used plates, which is unacceptable for any hotel. I have photographic evidence of this. There is no parking facility, which caused further inconvenience.

The staff was unprofessional, careless, and unresponsive throughout my stay. This hotel does not meet even basic hospitality standards and seriously damages the Treebo brand image.

Overall, this is a third-class hotel with third-class service. I strongly do not recommend this property to anyone.
